name: Uninstall cleanup on multisite
query: Our plugin can be network-activated. Make uninstall remove its options and custom table from every site.
expected_behavior: Step 3: Iterate get_sites() with switch_to_blog()/restore_current_blog() and clean each site's options and $wpdb->prefix table
Step 4: Delete network options with delete_site_option()
Step 5: Handle sites created after network activation (wp_initialize_site) and deleted sites (wp_uninitialize_site)
success_criteria: Every switch_to_blog() has a matching restore_current_blog()
Per-site and network data are both removed
Only data the plugin created is deleted
